page: Microsoft Azure L80as_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine within the LASv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD processor providing 80 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 640.0 GB, establishing a high memory allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The server profile does not include GPU accelerators.

A central characteristic of the L80as_v3 is its integrated high-capacity direct-attached storage, providing 20059 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity in addition to Premium Storage capabilities. Consolidating extensive local solid-state storage with dedicated compute and high RAM density avoids latency bottlenecks associated with network-attached storage. From a resource perspective, this dense configuration yields qualitative cost efficiency for large data operations by reducing the need to scale out multiple smaller nodes to achieve equivalent local storage capacity.

Given its hardware specifications, the L80as_v3 is built for input/output intensive applications. It is suited for large-scale relational and NoSQL databases, data warehousing platforms, big data analytics engines, and comprehensive ETL data processing pipelines.

A primary feature of this configuration is its integrated 20059 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, supplemented by Premium Storage support. This high-density local storage and memory layout eliminates off-node storage transfer latencies and optimizes cost efficiency for workloads requiring immense low-latency disk capacity alongside substantial system memory. The hardware configuration makes the L80as_v3 well adapted for high-throughput NoSQL and relational database systems, large data warehousing operations, distributed file management, and demanding ETL data processing pipelines.
